description: This file contains mock factory functions and utilities for mocking Node.js built-in modules, including functions to resolve mock overrides, default exports, and creating mocked modules with optional default mirroring.

methods.name: function resolveMockOverrides<TModule extends object>( resolveMockOverrides
methods.description: Resolves mock overrides for a module, accepting either a partial module or a function returning a partial module.

methods.description: Extracts the default export from a module if present and is an object, otherwise returns the module itself.
